blurb: Scallop Cove Too! offers rentals of pontoons, kayaks, bikes, beach carts, chairs, umbrellas, BBQs, and other beach gear. It is located in the St. Joe State Park and provides equipment for riding, relaxing, and enjoying Cape San Blas. The business is part of the Scallop Cove family, which also includes a general store and bait & tackle shop.
